text.en:
The monthly base pay prescribed for commissioned officers of the Armed Forces of the
Philippines under General Orders No. 11, dated October 1, 1972 shall be the basis of the retirement gratuity or
pensions of officers retired from the military service prior to October 1, 1972.

This Decree shall take effect upon approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
